description: Monitoring accounts; rebalancing; placing discretionary trades; raising cash for client needs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients are exposed to market moves while trading is down; cash requests and trade errors must be handled within a trading day; positions of record sit at the custodian so little data can be lost; RPO covers model and trade notes on the portfolio platform
manual_workaround: Place urgent trades by phone through the custodian's adviser service desk after its identity checks; defer rebalancing
dependent_third_parties: Qualified custodian; portfolio platform vendor; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-adviser (single point of failure; only person with trading authority); home office

business_process: Client money movement and service requests
description: Withdrawals; distributions and required minimum distributions; transfers between accounts; bank and address changes; custodian forms for e-signature
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A wrong or fraudulent payment can cost a client tens of thousands of dollars that the adviser may have to repay; a missed distribution can cost a client a tax penalty; integrity matters more than speed
manual_workaround: Client calls the custodian directly for urgent withdrawals; owner verifies every request by calling the number on file (P06 POL-01 7.6)
dependent_third_parties: Qualified custodian; e-signature vendor; email provider

description: Email; phone calls; video meetings; scheduling; sending review letters
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients expect a reply within one business day; market events raise call volume
manual_workaround: Phone calls from the mobile phone; the custodian's client service line; a printed client contact list kept in the locked file cabinet
dependent_third_parties: Email provider; phone carrier; video meeting service

description: Quarterly fee calculation and fee instructions to the custodian; quarterly performance reports; business bookkeeping
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $45,000 is billed each quarter in arrears; a week's delay moves cash flow but harms no client; wrong fee deductions are a regulatory and client issue
manual_workaround: Calculate fees from custodian statements in a spreadsheet and submit the fee file through the custodian portal; delay reports
dependent_third_parties: Portfolio platform vendor; qualified custodian; accounting SaaS vendor

description: Books and records; Form ADV updates; client agreements; responding to written requests from the Florida OFR; annual compliance review
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines are measured in days; the OFR may summarily suspend a registration if requested records are not promptly provided (Fla. Stat. 517.121(3)); RPO of 24 hours is not supported today because the only independent copy is a weekly USB backup (about 168 hours)
manual_workaround: Retrieve records from the custodian (statements and confirmations) and the e-signature service (signed agreements); rebuild the rest from the USB copy
dependent_third_parties: Email and file provider; compliance consultant; qualified custodian
